given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser is logged in and views the Product Catalog
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits a new product entry with all required fields filled
given_when_then.then: The system creates the new entry, assigns it as the current version, and displays a success message

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry with a missing required field
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the request and displays an error message indicating the missing field

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser attempts to update a product entry that is in an archived state
given_when_then.when: The Merchandiser submits the update request
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the update and indicates the product is in an archived state

given_when_then.given: The Merchandiser updates a product entry with valid data
given_when_then.when: The system processes the change history logic
given_when_then.then: The system retains previous versions of the product and marks them as archived

success_criteria: A product entry cannot be updated if it is in an archived state.
All product updates must include a timestamp and the identifier of the user making the change.
Required fields such as product name and price must be populated before a new entry is created.
Previous versions of a product must be retained and marked as archived when a new version is published.
